feed.title: AI Benefits Database: feed of new and revised cases

entry.title: Newham proposes AI forecasting for temporary-accommodation planning
entry.summary: Newham Council and the University of East London propose using existing data to forecast housing demand and homelessness trends. Better temporary-accommodation planning remains an intended benefit.

entry.title: Proposed AI rainfall prediction for basin irrigation
entry.summary: IARI proposes AI rainfall prediction to avoid unnecessary irrigation when rain is expected. The report separates this proposed extension from its existing soil-moisture automation.

entry.title: Proposed AI decision support for human resources
entry.summary: A UAE research project proposes AI decision support for HR personnel. Better decisions, lower costs, and reduced hiring bias remain intended benefits.

entry.title: Wigan reports time savings and newly usable survey responses
entry.summary: Wigan reports 107 staff days saved on minutes and new analysis of 4,500 tenant responses through QuickAction tools.

entry.title: West Oxfordshire and Cotswold report less planning admin
entry.summary: West Oxfordshire and Cotswold report 85% less repetitive planning-administration time with AI tagging and summaries of consultation feedback.

entry.title: West Berkshire reports quicker job-advert drafting with GPT
entry.summary: West Berkshire reports faster, more consistently formatted job adverts from its GPT tool, with low stated setup and running costs.

entry.title: The Amelia Scott reports better scans and expanded digital exhibits
entry.summary: The Amelia Scott reports 50% faster image processing, improved scans, interactive exhibits, and volunteers progressing to paid museum roles.

entry.title: West Midlands uses near-miss data to change road layouts
entry.summary: Transport for West Midlands reports 61,000 detected near misses and road-layout changes informed by AI. Avoided injuries are not established.

entry.title: Swindon reports cheaper, faster Easy-Read documents
entry.summary: Swindon reports that Simply Readable creates Easy-Read documents in under 30 minutes at much lower cost, with input from residents with learning disabilities.

entry.title: Surrey Heath explores Copilot meeting and email summaries
entry.summary: Surrey Heath reports promising meeting-recap and email-summary tests with two Copilot licenses. It has not established a business case or quantified gains.

entry.title: St Helens uses AI to match care needs and draft care plans
entry.summary: St Helens built AI tools that match care assessments to a technology catalog and draft personalized care plans. Improved resident independence remains an intended benefit.

entry.title: South Cambridgeshire reports fewer calls and better routing
entry.summary: South Cambridgeshire reports lower call volumes after chatbot rollout and better call classification, without numerical savings or satisfaction results.

entry.title: Somerset reports time savings and improved staff focus
entry.summary: Somerset reports two to four hours saved weekly per Copilot user, with 75% reporting better focus and 53% finding work more enjoyable.

entry.title: Peterborough develops OSCAR to connect council AI services
entry.summary: OSCAR is a proof-of-concept framework for a shared council digital front door. Its own accessibility and integration benefits remain prospective.

entry.title: Peterborough reports quicker advice through Hey Geraldine
entry.summary: Peterborough reports 15 minutes saved per conversation with Hey Geraldine. A manager describes obtaining equipment information while a colleague was away.

entry.title: North Yorkshire reports faster social-care data retrieval
entry.summary: North Yorkshire reports 90% less time and cost for some data-retrieval tasks in its Azure AI proof of concept, plus relationship-mapping tools.

entry.title: North East Derbyshire explores Copilot for routine work
entry.summary: North East Derbyshire uses Copilot for drafting, summaries, and analysis. Reduced repetitive work remains intended; the source does not establish an AI-produced cultural benefit.

entry.title: Northumberland develops FloodAI for six flash-flood catchments
entry.summary: Northumberland describes an alpha-stage flood-forecasting service for six catchments. No issued warning or avoided flood impact is reported.

entry.title: Milton Keynes reports faster planning validation with Valon
entry.summary: Milton Keynes reports faster validation and decisions during its Valon pilot, with receipt-to-validation time falling from 15.8 to 7.6 days.

entry.title: Leeds reports more planning applications processed with Xylo
entry.summary: Leeds reports over 40% more applications processed per officer, less research time, and improved officer wellbeing during its Xylo pilot.

entry.title: Lancashire uses AI traffic insights to support route planning
entry.summary: Lancashire reports that AI traffic predictions, junction observations, and congestion analysis support transport decisions and bus-route planning.

entry.title: Kingston reports shorter social-care documentation with AI
entry.summary: Kingston reports that Magic Notes cuts documentation time by 50–60%, with supervision write-ups falling from 40 minutes to under 10.

entry.title: Kent reports fewer homeless households after targeted support
entry.summary: Kent reports under 1% homelessness among proactively supported households versus 40% in an unsupported comparator. The groups were not randomized.

entry.title: Hertfordshire trials an AI robot that repairs road cracks
entry.summary: Hertfordshire reports that its ARRES pilot fixed a small number of road cracks. Long-term repair quality, safety, and cost benefits remain unmeasured.

entry.title: Halton introduces a family-hub digital front door
entry.summary: Halton reports that its family-hub platform offers round-the-clock information and that automation has begun reducing administrative work.

entry.title: Greater Cambridge reports faster consultation summaries
entry.summary: Greater Cambridge reports that a consultation-summary task fell from 18.5 officer hours to 16 AI minutes while officers still read every response.

entry.title: Dorset plans acoustic monitoring in six care homes
entry.summary: Dorset plans 184 acoustic and movement sensors to support care. The source reports intended sleep and falls benefits, before outcome evaluation.

entry.title: Buckinghamshire reports time savings and better deaf access
entry.summary: Buckinghamshire reports that Copilot shortens call wrap-up and supports a deaf colleague in participating in meetings more independently.

entry.title: Bradford adds multilingual, out-of-hours social-care advice
entry.summary: Bradford reports that Annie handles about 50 conversations weekly, with 20% outside office hours and 74% user satisfaction.

entry.title: Birmingham reports faster redaction and automated email indexing
entry.summary: Birmingham reports that AI redacts documents in 90 seconds instead of 10 minutes and indexes 55% of emails, saving staff time and costs.

entry.title: Barnsley reports less administrative work with Copilot
entry.summary: Barnsley reports that Copilot saves time on meeting notes, summaries, procurement, legal work, and social-care administration.

entry.title: Soil sensors support proposed fertilizer advice
entry.summary: MUST is developing sensor-based soil analysis and a random-forest advisory model. Yield improvements and lower fertilizer waste remain intended.

entry.title: Edge AI detects tomato diseases on a demonstration farm
entry.summary: MUST reports a tomato-disease detection pilot using edge AI. Avoided crop losses, higher yields, and reduced pesticide use remain unmeasured.

entry.title: Divine Farmer provides agricultural guidance
entry.summary: China Telecom reports agricultural Q&A accuracy above 90% and pest/disease recognition above 85%. These technical capabilities do not establish yield or income gains.

entry.title: Zimbabwe pilots an agricultural voice-advice center
entry.summary: POTRAZ describes pilots in three wards using voice and SMS agricultural advice. The chapter's income, loss-reduction, and adoption figures are projections.

entry.title: Local soil and weather intelligence for farmers
entry.summary: A TinyML weather-monitoring prototype supports a proposed farm-advisory system. Yield, income, and resource-saving effects are not reported.

entry.title: Simulating AI advice for electric-vehicle endurance
entry.summary: Researchers report simulated energy-efficiency gains of about 9.2% from driving advice. The system has not been deployed, so real vehicle and emissions benefits remain unknown.

entry.title: Detecting attacks on vehicle communications
entry.summary: AI4Africa proposes intrusion detection for V2V networks. The chapter reports no intercepted attack or realized safety benefit.

entry.title: AI-enabled 6G vehicle communications
entry.summary: AI4Africa proposes 6G-V2X networks for connected transport. The system has no deployment, and mobility benefits remain prospective.

entry.title: V2V coordination for narrow and congested roads
entry.summary: OptM describes controlled pilots of vehicle communication and AI coordination. Safer journeys, smoother traffic, and lower emissions remain expected.

entry.title: Voice commands orchestrate in-vehicle functions
entry.summary: Changan reports that its vehicle agent reduces scenario-configuration tasks from minutes to seconds. Safety and environmental benefits remain unmeasured.

entry.title: Simulating coordinated vehicle decisions
entry.summary: TCS is researching low-cost decision making for vehicle groups. Safer traffic and lower fuel use remain intended benefits of the simulated approach.

entry.title: CargoWaves reports faster, more efficient logistics
entry.summary: DP World reports 30% higher cargo throughput and 20% lower CO2 per shipment through CargoWaves. The chapter does not isolate AI from wider digital workflow improvements.

entry.title: Apollo Go adds accessible robotaxi controls
entry.summary: Baidu reports a limited rollout of audible arrival alerts, automatic unlocking, and voice controls for visually impaired passengers. Long-term mobility effects are unmeasured.

entry.title: Tanbeeh speeds gate entry at DP World
entry.summary: DP World reports that Tanbeeh reduced gate entry from three minutes to 15 seconds. The platform also monitors fire and protective equipment; prevented injuries are unproven.

entry.title: Safer autonomous wheelchair navigation in development
entry.summary: SUPSI and IDSIA developed a laboratory demonstrator for autonomous wheelchair safety. Independent mobility benefits remain prospective.

entry.title: Eye gestures for hands-free computer control
entry.summary: An Ethiopian project combines vision models and eye tracking for computer control. Functional benefits for users remain intended while development continues.

entry.title: A prototype for Indian Sign Language translation
entry.summary: IIIT Hyderabad is developing an ISL recognition and translation proof of concept. Communication and education benefits remain prospective.

entry.title: UNHCR develops Kurdish speech transcription
entry.summary: UNHCR is fine-tuning Kurdish speech recognition for humanitarian interviews. Faster processing and more inclusive decisions remain intended benefits.

entry.title: CareVia reports less recording work and self-harm
entry.summary: SK Telecom reports recording time falling from three hours to five minutes and 76.5% fewer self-harm incidents. Its supplied reference does not identify the claimed intervention study.

entry.title: Vivo adds offline AI accessibility tools
entry.summary: Vivo describes on-device speech, vision, and sign-language features that work offline. Their direct accessibility benefits are reported; wider social effects are unmeasured.

entry.title: AI lip-reading training reports restored speech
entry.summary: Huazhong University reports that 343 deaf users regained speech capabilities with AI-guided lip-reading practice. The chapter also claims threefold learning efficiency.

entry.title: A more inclusive AI drowsiness detector
entry.summary: Catalink is validating a driver-monitoring prototype. Fewer crashes and safer public transport remain intended outcomes.

entry.title: AI sign-language broadcasting at the Winter Olympics
entry.summary: Baidu reports that XiLing provided round-the-clock sign-language coverage during the 2022 Winter Olympics, with over 100 million live and replay views.

entry.title: AI optimizes layouts for low-income housing
entry.summary: VIT is testing space optimization on synthetic and reference floor plans. Improved living space and construction outcomes remain prospective.

entry.title: Predicting network quality for online events
entry.summary: AI4Africa proposes forecasting connection quality to help plan online events. Avoided disruption and access benefits are not yet reported.

entry.title: Dubai housing gains have unclear achieved-versus-expected status
entry.summary: MBRHE gives a housing-service reduction from 84 to 32 months and faster approvals, but describes the figures as both delivered features and expected benefits. Whether they were achieved is unclear.

entry.title: Proposed AI model for satellite-dish realignment
entry.summary: MUST proposes training an AI model on dish-misalignment patterns to improve realignment. Its current design uses stored angles and feedback controls; AI-related gains remain unmeasured.

entry.title: OneAstronomy improves astronomy benchmark performance
entry.summary: Zhejiang Lab and NAOC report that OneAstronomy outperformed comparison models on astronomy benchmarks. Discoveries and public benefits remain unmeasured.

entry.title: Yi Jiang Jie offers AI-guided museum visits
entry.summary: China Telecom describes an interactive museum guide with contextual explanations and personalized routes. Visitor and institutional outcomes remain unmeasured.
